text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector fused to the opening negation, carrying the prior value audit into a new denial
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the previous correction rather than opening an isolated maxim. Because it is fused to the negator, continuation and denial arrive together: the value audit of provision now turns directly against wealth and children as measures of nearness.

topics.headline: resumptive negating opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial continues the prior value audit instead of starting a detached maxim.
topics.reason: The particle is attached to the opening negation and the boundary evidence connects the ayah to the previous correction.

words.gloss_range: negative particle denying the access-function of wealth and children, not their existence
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates the predicate relation, not the reality of the possessions. The ayah denies that wealth and children function as access-makers, and the later exception turns this negation into restriction: false criteria are cleared before the faith-and-action person is admitted.

topics.headline: access relation denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation cancels wealth and children as access-makers, not as existing possessions.
topics.reason: The negative particle governs the nominal predication and targets the predicate relation.

topics.headline: negation prepares exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the opening denial preparing the later exception that identifies the valid route.
topics.reason: The later exception particle completes the restriction opened by the negation.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural resources as claimed social capital; locally denied any power to create divine nearness
words.root_gloss_range: resources, property, livestock, and usable capital; locally the concrete asset field is denied access-value
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ}} ({{tr:amwālukum}}) names owned, plural resources, so the denial is aimed at the addressees' concrete social capital rather than wealth in abstraction. Its tangible field includes counted livestock, usable property, and survival resources, but the grammar strips that whole asset class of access power. Its pairing with children answers the boast-field of 34:35 and the adornment contrast of 18:46, making the first prestige term part of a larger dismantling of status as proof.

topics.headline: owned plural resources denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees' own varied resources are denied access power, not wealth as an abstract topic.
topics.reason: Plural possession and the second-person suffix make the claim directly addressed.

topics.headline: concrete resource field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tangible asset field behind the word while local syntax keeps the point as denied access-value.
topics.reason: The root pressure is valid as concrete resource imagery, but the local clause uses it inside a negated access claim.

topics.headline: wealth and children as prestige pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word as the first half of a familiar status pair answered by 34:35 and contrasted with enduring deeds in 18:46.
topics.reason: The row evidence ties the pair to same-surah boasting and broader wealth-children contrast.

topics.headline: wealth leads the paired denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the critique beginning with assets and then expanding to lineage.
topics.reason: The word precedes the children term, setting the first step of the paired denial.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that brings children under the same negated access claim as wealth
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second prestige noun into the same denied predicate. The connector prevents children from becoming a separate criterion after wealth is rejected; the two are handled as one social field under negation.

topics.headline: second term joined under denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lineage is coordinated into the same denied prestige field as wealth.
topics.reason: The connector joins the second noun to the first within the same negated predicate frame.

words.gloss_range: repeated negative marker giving lineage its own explicit exclusion inside the coordinated pair
words.prose: {{ar:لَآ}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives the second noun its own negative marker. The ayah does not merely deny wealth and then mention lineage; it marks lineage as independently excluded from the access claim.

topics.headline: lineage explicitly excluded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second status term receives its own negative marker, blocking lineage as a fallback route.
topics.reason: The particle stands before the second coordinated noun and reinforces the neither-nor structure.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural offspring and lineage capital; locally denied any proximity-generating force
words.root_gloss_range: birth, begetting, offspring, and generated lineage; locally the descent field is denied access-value
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْلَٰدُكُم}} ({{tr:awlādukum}}) brings possessed descendants into the same negated frame as wealth. The birth and lineage field makes the denial bodily and social: even household continuity and heirs cannot become nearness. In sequence, children broaden the critique from transferable assets to embodied legacy, while 18:46 keeps the pair visible as worldly adornment displaced by righteous deeds.

topics.headline: owned lineage denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees' descendants and household continuity are denied proximity-force.
topics.reason: Plural possession makes lineage a directly addressed social asset under negation.

topics.headline: birth and descent pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the concrete birth-and-descent field, while local grammar keeps it as a denied access claim.
topics.reason: The root pressure remains useful as lineage imagery but does not create a separate route to nearness.

topics.headline: children complete the status pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices children completing the wealth-and-offspring prestige system that 18:46 and 34:35 put under critique.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect the paired nouns to same-surah and cross-passage contrasts.

topics.headline: lineage broadens the critique
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the denial expanding from property to embodied legacy.
topics.reason: The second position broadens the status field after wealth.

words.gloss_range: predicate preposition marking the alleged means or access category under negation
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns the denied predicate into a means-category. The issue is not mere possession, but the claim that possessions are the instrument or basis by which nearness is produced; the attached relative phrase makes that access mechanism the target.

topics.headline: denied means category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar judges a claimed access-means, not merely the objects possessed.
topics.reason: The preposition forms the predicate under negation and can mark means, attachment, or basis.

topics.headline: predicate compressed with relative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the preposition and relative head forming one category frame for the rejected mechanism.
topics.reason: The written attachment and preposed predicate phrase make the access category visible.

words.gloss_range: feminine singular relative head collecting the failed means into one access category
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) heads the relative category completed by the near-bringing verb. The canonical feminine singular form compresses wealth and children into one failed access class; variant evidence can distribute or abstract that category, but it preserves the same prepositional predicate frame.

topics.headline: relative defines failed access class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices wealth and children gathered into a single category defined by supposed near-bringing.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun heads the predicate and requires the following verb to define the category.

topics.headline: variants expose category shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant readings alter whether the failed means is compressed, abstracted, or distributed, while the canonical frame remains one failed access class.
topics.reason: The variants clarify agreement and number without replacing the canonical local structure.

words.gloss_range: causative near-bringing imagined for wealth and children, explicitly negated in relation to the addressees
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, approach, access, and offering-like approach; locally selected in a negated causative access claim
words.prose: {{ar:تُقَرِّبُكُمْ}} ({{tr:tuqarribukum}}) is the operative verb of the false mechanism: possessions are imagined as causing the addressees to move nearer, and the negation cancels that claim. The approach field includes offering-like access, so the denial is sharper than a denial of vague honor. Variant evidence shows different ways the mechanism could be construed, but the canonical Form II causative keeps the addressees as the direct target. The phrase also contrasts with embodied nearness in 96:19 and resolves the provision misreading from 34:36.

topics.headline: possessions imagined as near-bringing agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the false mechanism as causative: the addressees are the direct object supposedly moved nearer.
topics.reason: The Form II imperfect takes the second-person plural object and agrees with the relative category.

topics.headline: approach and offering pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the offering-like approach pressure, while local grammar keeps it inside a negated access mechanism.
topics.reason: The root range supports approach and offering imagery, but the local claim is specifically denied.

topics.headline: variant causation contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant evidence can shift the mechanism toward approximation, while the canonical reading selects causative near-bringing.
topics.reason: The variant readings sharpen the semantic contrast but do not govern the canonical parse.

topics.headline: false route contrasted with real approach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices possessions rejected as a rival route to nearness, in contrast with 96:19 and the provision misreading from 34:36.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references for embodied approach and the preceding provision frame.

topics.headline: nearness field concentrated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the near-bringing verb driving the rejected mechanism and being intensified by the nearby nearness noun.
topics.reason: The local phrase stacks two proximity terms and places the verb inside the defining relative clause.

words.gloss_range: divine-side presence and evaluation; the scale before which possessions fail as proof
words.root_gloss_range: presence beside, withness, and evaluative standing; locally the divine assessment side
words.prose: {{ar:عِندَنَا}} ({{tr:ʿindanā}}) relocates the whole measurement to the divine side. Its presence-and-evaluation range makes nearness feel like being right beside the assessing presence with no practical gap, so wealth and children fail both as actual access and as proof of standing. The suffix fixes the assessing side, and the ayah later turns evaluated nearness into granted placement rather than self-produced rank.

topics.headline: evaluation located with God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the measuring side shift from the audience's status map to divine presence and judgment.
topics.reason: The adverbial with first-person plural suffix functions as the locative and evaluative complement.

topics.headline: presence and estimation range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nearness means both access and standing, while local syntax keeps it as the complement to the denied near-bringing claim.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports presence and estimation but is selected locally by the near-bringing clause.

topics.headline: same scale continues to final placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine-side evaluation later resolving as granted high dwelling, not self-measured rank.
topics.reason: The rows connect the term to reward, action, same-surah evaluation, and the boundary from 34:36.

words.gloss_range: ranked or degree nearness named as the access-state possessions cannot produce
words.root_gloss_range: approach, privileged closeness, rank-nearness, and staged nearness; locally a compact denied access-state
words.prose: {{ar:زُلْفَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:zulfā}}) thickens the near-bringing verb by naming the desired rank-nearness itself. Its root field gives the access claim a sense of deliberate approach and privileged closeness, and the trough-gathering image makes that closeness feel like valued convergence, while the canonical noun keeps the local sense as compact rank-nearness. The plural variant can make nearness staged, and the local doublet first intensifies the false route before the exception redirects it. The disputed-nearness logic in 39:3 and the Garden brought near in 50:31 show claimed access versus granted nearness.

topics.headline: ranked nearness named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied outcome is privileged rank-nearness, not a vague honor.
topics.reason: The noun functions as a cognate or degree accusative and names the access-state.

topics.headline: desired convergence image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a concrete pull toward valued closeness, while the local phrase keeps the point as denied rank-nearness.
topics.reason: The image is valid pressure but does not replace the local nearness noun.

topics.headline: variant staged nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant evidence can make nearness staged or plural, while the canonical noun keeps it compact.
topics.reason: The variant reading clarifies gradability without replacing the canonical form.

topics.headline: proximity doublet redirects route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah intensifying the false proximity claim before redirecting the route through the exception, with parallels in 39:3 and 50:31.
topics.reason: The rows connect the local doublet with concrete reference points and the later exception.

words.gloss_range: exception particle pivoting from excluded possessions to the valid person-defined route
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge from exclusion to replacement. Since the denied subjects are possessions and the exception introduces a person, the particle does not rescue a better possession; it shifts the valid route to a human response defined by faith and work.

topics.headline: possessions replaced by a person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah changing categories: not better possessions, but a morally described person.
topics.reason: The exception follows negation and introduces a personal head after non-person subjects.

words.gloss_range: generic personal relative or condition-like head opening individual qualification and later class formation
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the exception as a person rather than a thing. It is grammatically singular but semantically open, so individual entry becomes a rewarded class when the later demonstrative appears. The boundary from 34:36 is now applied as a concrete correction of the audience's criteria.

topics.headline: singular entry becomes class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices individual eligibility becoming a visible rewarded class.
topics.reason: The singular generic head later resumes as a plural demonstrative.

topics.headline: person replaces owned things
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the criterion moving from what one has to the person who believes and acts.
topics.reason: The word fills the exception slot and governs the following qualifying clause.

topics.headline: previous ignorance applied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the previous value error becoming a direct criterion correction in this ayah.
topics.reason: Boundary rows connect 34:36 to the applied reversal in 34:37.

words.gloss_range: completed faith or trust as the first qualifying act within the exception
words.root_gloss_range: trust, faith, safety, and security; locally entry into trust that later becomes secure outcome
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنَ}} ({{tr:āmana}}) supplies the first qualifying act after the person-based exception. Its perfect form presents faith as a defining completed quality, and its trust-security root prepares the final secure state. The faith-and-work formula echoes the surah's reward pattern and wider passages such as 2:25, while the same root later closes as security.

topics.headline: completed qualifying trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith as the completed individual qualifier that replaces inherited advantage.
topics.reason: The perfect Form IV verb resumes the singular personal head.

topics.headline: trust field prepares security
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith belongs to a trust-security field that later becomes experienced safety.
topics.reason: The root range is valid pressure, while the local form selects entering faith or trust.

topics.headline: faith and sound work formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase joining the wider reward formula, including 2:25 and 34:4.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete formula parallels.

topics.headline: route closes as security
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root framing the valid route and final secure outcome.
topics.reason: The local root echo runs from the qualifying verb to the final participle.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector binding faith and action as one qualifying profile
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds action to faith inside the same exception clause. The connector does not rank action as a detachable supplement; it makes the valid route a coupled profile that blocks both inherited status and bare claim.

topics.headline: faith and action coupled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices action bound to faith as a co-criterion, not an optional add-on.
topics.reason: The connector joins the second qualifying verb inside the same exception clause.

words.gloss_range: completed accountable action by the same qualifying person, later mirrored as reward basis
words.root_gloss_range: work, deed, produced result, and accountable performance; locally enacted qualification
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلَ}} ({{tr:ʿamila}}) gives the same qualifying person completed, accountable action. The work field is concrete and inspectable, like purposeful hand-work that leaves a product, so value moves from what one possesses to what one performs. Because the root returns later in the reward basis, action becomes both entry criterion and evidence for recompense.

topics.headline: achieved action by same person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith and action belong to the same qualifying person and share completed aspect.
topics.reason: The verb carries the same implicit singular subject and matches the previous perfect.

topics.headline: inspectable work output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices action as produced, accountable work rather than claimed status.
topics.reason: The root field supplies output and labor pressure within the local qualifying verb.

topics.headline: work returns as reward evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices action first qualifying the person and later grounding the recompense.
topics.reason: The rows connect the word to faith, soundness, and the later repeated action root.

words.gloss_range: sound, fitting, restorative deed-quality compressed into an accusative qualifier
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, repair, suitability, and reconciliation; locally the fitness filter on action
words.prose: {{ar:صَٰلِحًۭا}} ({{tr:ṣāliḥan}}) filters action by soundness. Its accusative form can carry deed-content or manner, and the repair-fitness field makes the action restorative rather than merely impressive. The familiar faith-and-sound-work formula, including the contrast in 18:46, turns work into rewardable work only after this quality is supplied.

topics.headline: deed content and manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one compact accusative form carrying both deed-content and evaluative manner.
topics.reason: The form can stand for a compressed deed expression or manner after the action verb.

topics.headline: soundness as restorative fitness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices righteous work as fitted and order-restoring, not merely active or admired.
topics.reason: The root range supports repair and suitability, and the participial form makes soundness a deed property.

topics.headline: enduring deeds replace status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the 18:46 contrast turning from adornment to the explicit route of sound work.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete wealth-children versus enduring-deeds parallel.

words.gloss_range: result connector moving immediately from qualification to assigned outcome
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the consequence immediate. The exception clause behaves like a condition, and this particle moves straight from eligibility to distribution, so the qualified class is not left as an abstract definition.

topics.headline: qualification becomes outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exception immediately turning into assigned result.
topics.reason: The result particle marks the answer to the condition-like personal clause.

words.gloss_range: plural demonstrative turning the singular generic qualifier into an identifiable rewarded class
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ʾulāʾika}}) restarts the sentence with the qualified people in view. It pluralizes the open singular person into an identifiable class and foregrounds the recipients before their recompense is named.

topics.headline: qualified people made visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the singular open qualifier becoming an identifiable plural class before reward.
topics.reason: The plural demonstrative resumes the personal head and restarts the reward frame.

words.gloss_range: allocation preposition assigning the reward to the qualified class before the reward is named
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) assigns the reward before the reward noun appears. Its allocation and benefit force make the doubled recompense an allotted share for the qualified class, not a loose description near them.

topics.headline: reward assigned before named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recipient entitlement foregrounded before the recompense content appears.
topics.reason: The preposition marks specification, benefit, and allocation in a fronted phrase.

words.gloss_range: attached plural recipient pronoun tying the allocation to the demonstrative class
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the allocation tied to the same plural class just identified. The pronoun is fused to the entitlement marker, so recipient and assignment are heard before the recompense itself.

topics.headline: same class receives reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward stays tied to the same plural class formed after the exception.
topics.reason: The attached pronoun is governed by the allocation preposition and resumes the demonstrative class.

words.gloss_range: nominal recompense bound to the doubled amount and grounded in deeds
words.root_gloss_range: recompense, requital, settlement of account, and response to action; locally stable reward allotment
words.prose: {{ar:جَزَآءُ}} ({{tr:jazāʾu}}) names recompense as a stable allotment and, in the canonical construct, binds that recompense to doubling. The requital root keeps the generosity tethered to moral accounting, like settling or balancing an account: the reward answers deeds rather than status. Variant case evidence can loosen the relation, but the canonical phrase packages multiplication inside the reward.

topics.headline: recompense bound to doubling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the canonical construct making multiplication internal to the reward phrase.
topics.reason: The canonical construct tightens recompense and doubling, while variants show possible loosening.

topics.headline: measured account settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices generosity as recompense that still answers action.
topics.reason: The verbal noun and root field frame the reward as stable requital rather than arbitrary privilege.

topics.headline: multiplication tied to deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices doubled reward staying connected to deeds, with 6:160 as a wider multiplication parallel.
topics.reason: The rows provide a concrete cross-passage multiplication reference.

words.gloss_range: definite doubled amount inside the reward construct, with folding/multiplication overtaking weakness
words.root_gloss_range: weakness and doubling through folding or multiplication; locally the reward multiplier, not weakness
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلضِّعْفِ}} ({{tr:aḍ-ḍiʿfi}}) supplies the defined multiplier within the reward construct. The root's folding field lets weakness and multiplication meet: what looked socially weak can be returned as amplified reward. Same-surah pressure from 34:31-33 and the deed basis around it keep the doubling tied to performed action, while variant case evidence shows how tightly the canonical genitive binds multiplier to recompense. The doubled consonantal weight also lets the fold-word sound heavy at the center of the reward phrase.

topics.headline: known multiplier in construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the doubled amount packaged as the reward content rather than an indefinite bonus.
topics.reason: The definite genitive is governed in the canonical construct, while variants expose other syntactic roles.

topics.headline: weakness turned to multiplication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the fold field reversing weakness into multiplied return.
topics.reason: The root range includes weakness and doubling, but the local noun selects multiplication.

topics.headline: oppressed weak answered by doubled reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root moving from social weakening in 34:31-33 to multiplied reward in 34:37, with 2:261 widening the multiplication image.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah and cross-passage references.

topics.headline: action remains basis while scale changes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices doubled reward magnifying deeds without replacing deeds as the stated ground.
topics.reason: The rows connect the multiplier to repeated action and the reward basis.

topics.headline: audible heaviness of multiplier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sound reinforcing the weight of the fold or multiplier word.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds a distinct local cadence payoff.

words.gloss_range: causal basis preposition tying the multiplied recompense to what was done
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) grounds the multiplied reward in the deed clause. The causal-basis force prevents doubling from floating free as privilege; it is attached to what was actually done, and its postposition lets the ayah name the allotment first and then specify its basis.

topics.headline: reward grounded in deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the doubled recompense tied to performed action rather than inherited possession.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the basis phrase and fuses to the following particle.

topics.headline: basis specified after reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah first naming reward and multiplier, then anchoring them in what was done.
topics.reason: The basis phrase follows the reward cluster.

words.gloss_range: relative or nominalizing particle gathering the full deed-content as reward basis
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) gathers the deed-content governed by the causal preposition. It leaves the field open as what they did or their doing, so recompense tracks actual agency rather than a named status label. Its sound also answers the opening negator by turning denial into accountable content.

topics.headline: whole deed field gathered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recompense tracking the whole performed field, not a fixed status label or named deed list.
topics.reason: The particle can be relative or source-like while preserving the same basis relation.

topics.headline: basis closes reward rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact basis phrase preventing doubled recompense from floating free.
topics.reason: The phrase links the reward cluster to its explanatory ground.

topics.headline: second particle reverses the opening sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated particle sound shifting from denied access to accountable content.
topics.reason: The second occurrence is relative rather than negative, creating a local contrast with the opening negation.

words.gloss_range: plural completed action as the collective record grounding recompense
words.root_gloss_range: work, deed, produced result, and accountable performance; locally the class record used as reward basis
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) turns the earlier individual action into the class's completed record. The plural perfect matches the rewarded group and lands the basis phrase on performed deeds. By repeating the action root, the ayah makes work both the condition of entry and the evidence for doubled recompense.

topics.headline: singular entry becomes plural record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices individual qualification expanding into the class record used for recompense.
topics.reason: The plural perfect and suffix match the demonstrative class.

topics.headline: work grounds recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices action becoming evidence and basis for reward, not merely an entry condition.
topics.reason: The rows connect the root to recompense and doubling, with 16:97 as a concrete parallel.

topics.headline: basis phrase lands on action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices performed action as the final word of the recompense rationale.
topics.reason: The verb closes the basis phrase after the causal particle.

topics.headline: work mirrors condition and evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same work root linking the exception and the reward basis.
topics.reason: The repeated root makes the ayah self-accounting.

words.gloss_range: connector introducing the final settled state that accompanies the reward
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the reward frame into a final state clause. It can coordinate and also feel circumstantial, so secure habitation is not a detached second item but the settled state accompanying the allocation.

topics.headline: reward joined to settled state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final secure habitation attached to the reward frame as state, not detached reward-list item.
topics.reason: The connector introduces a nominal clause with coordinate and circumstantial force.

topics.headline: reward moves into security
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices measured recompense completing itself as inhabited safety.
topics.reason: The connector carries the clause from reward allocation to secure dwelling.

words.gloss_range: independent plural subject pronoun foregrounding the rewarded class in the final nominal state
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) foregrounds the rewarded class as occupants of the final state. The independent pronoun supports a nominal clause, shifting the close from an event to settled habitation and security.

topics.headline: rewarded class foregrounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the people themselves fixed as secure occupants, even though reference was recoverable.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is retained as the subject of the final nominal clause.

topics.headline: final state settled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the close shifting from event to abiding state.
topics.reason: The pronoun supports the nominal sentence that closes the ayah.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition placing security inside the elevated chambers as an inhabited state
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) places the secure class inside the chambers. Location and state work together here: the reward is not external recognition but an inhabited protected domain, with place stated before the security predicate.

topics.headline: security located inside chambers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices security as spatially inhabited within a protected domain.

words.gloss_range: definite plural elevated chambers as concrete granted placement after denied nearness
words.root_gloss_range: scooping, lifting, and raised chambers; locally concrete elevated habitation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغُرُفَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ghurufāti}}) gives the closing reward a concrete place. The definite plural presents prepared elevated dwellings, while the root's scooping-water-upward image turns denied abstract nearness into tangible granted elevation. Singular variant evidence narrows how number shapes the image, and parallels such as 25:75 and 29:58 confirm high chambers as reward for durable faithful response.

topics.headline: prepared elevated dwellings

topics.reason: The noun is definite plural and governed by the location preposition.

topics.headline: scooping and elevation made concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root image making final elevation tangible, while local sense remains elevated chambers.
topics.reason: The root field supports lifting pressure without replacing the local dwelling sense.

topics.headline: plural and singular chamber contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices canonical plural breadth against singular variant compression.
topics.reason: The variants clarify number and image while the canonical plural governs the local output.

topics.headline: reward chambers across passages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices high dwellings aligned with patient or faithful action in 25:75 and 29:58.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete chamber-reward references.

topics.headline: denied nearness becomes granted elevation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending with actual placement after rejecting attempted social access.
topics.reason: The final place image resolves the opening denied nearness claim.

words.gloss_range: plural active participle naming abiding security as the final state
words.root_gloss_range: faith, trust, safety, and freedom from fear; locally experienced security completing the faith route
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامِنُونَ}} ({{tr:āminūn}}) closes the ayah with abiding security. The active participle makes safety a settled condition, and the root returns from the earlier faith verb so trust becomes experienced protection and freedom from scanning for threat. The closing position, the parallel with secure station language in 44:51, and the terminal -ūn nasal cadence all land the ayah on protected stability rather than mere allocation.

topics.headline: active participle settled state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices security as an abiding shared condition, not a momentary rescue.
topics.reason: The plural active participle agrees with the final subject in a nominal clause.

topics.headline: faith becomes experienced safety

topics.reason: The root range supports the faith-security arc while the local form selects secure state.

topics.headline: secure station and chambers

topics.reason: The rows give a concrete secure-station reference.

topics.headline: route and outcome framed by one root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the valid route and endpoint bracketed by faith and security.
topics.reason: The local echo runs from the earlier faith verb to the final participle and answers the boundary problem.

topics.headline: settled nasal closure

topics.reason: The phonetic row gives a distinct cadence payoff at the ayah close.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated wealth and children are set against the exception of faith and fitting work in the construction about bringing near and having recompense.
baseline_models.mechanism: Accumulated property and lineage are proposed access credentials, but the exception transfers causality from possession to heart-settling assent expressed as intentional, fitting action. Courtly favor and rank branches make the denied claim specifically one of privileged access; action-corresponding recompense replaces it with an accountable route.

activation_trace.role: The branch is acquiring and multiplying property; it supplies the rejected quantitative credential.
The branch is offspring from lineage; it supplies inherited continuity as the second rejected credential.
The branch is courtly favor among a ruler's intimates; it makes bringing near a claim to privileged access.
The branch is proximity as rank and standing; it specifies the sought outcome as recognized station.
The branch is assent in which the heart settles; it supplies the qualifying trust rather than an owned badge.
The branch is purposive action; it makes agency, repeated in the causal phrase, the operative input.
The branch is fitness or suitability for a thing; it constrains action by aptness rather than volume.
The branch is answering an act with its recompense; it supplies the action-corresponding return.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and children might be badges that secure favored nearness, with faith and good deeds added as further merits.
changed_reading.after: The verse cancels property and lineage as access credentials and relocates the causal route entirely in settled assent made effective as intentional, fitting work and answered as recompense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of bringing near, presence with Us, nearness, lifting imagery in the chambers, and terminal safety forms a spatial chain within the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The proximity cluster begins with caused movement and presence, then culminates in being lifted or taken into upper rooms while secure. The final chambers are therefore not a detached luxury image: they spatialize granted nearness as stable placement, in contrast to assets that cannot transport their owners.

activation_trace.role: The branch is drawing near as the contrary of distance; it supplies the initial movement in the spatial chain.
The branch is presence and nearness at a thing; it supplies the destination as admitted presence.
The branch is forward movement into proximity; it intensifies nearness as an achieved approach.
The branch is lifting and taking something up; it supplies the vertical transition into the reward image.
The branch is an upper room above a building; it fixes the lifted destination as elevated habitation.
The branch is settled safety and trust; it makes the elevated placement stable rather than precarious.

changed_reading.before: Nearness is an abstract honor, while the chambers are a separate description of reward.
changed_reading.after: Nearness is enacted as a granted relocation: approach becomes admitted presence, elevation, and finally secure habitation, something possessions cannot cause.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wealth and offspring are grammatical possessions, whereas work is twice attached to the agents and to the ground of recompense.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch in which an offspring-like thing is generated from another broadens children into produced outcomes, while wealth is accumulated stock. The verse distinguishes what has accrued or issued from a person from what that person intentionally does; only the latter enters the recompense-and-increase circuit.

activation_trace.role: The branch is accumulated and multiplied property; it supplies stock already held.
The branch is something generated or newly produced from another; it broadens offspring into outcomes that issue from a source.
The branch is intentional action; it marks accountable doing rather than merely having an outcome.
The branch is an act met by its corresponding return; it links recompense specifically to doing.
The branch is adding an equal amount to a thing; it makes intentional doing the input that is multiplied.

changed_reading.before: The contrast is simply between worldly goods and religious merits.
changed_reading.after: The verse also distinguishes accrued or generated outcomes from accountable causation: what one has produced or inherited is not equivalent to what one now intentionally does.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first contracts the scale to a dispersed particle, fixes even that scale in an obligating record, and immediately states the faith-work-recompense sequence before the focus ayah adds increase by an equal. This turns the focus contrast into a precise action-accounting system: visible stores are not the unit of nearness, while even minute action remains legible and returnable.

activation_trace.role: The branch is the minuteness and dispersal of particles; it sets the accounting scale below conspicuous wealth.
The branch is inscription that fixes a ruling or measure; it supplies an obligating record for what is minute.
The branch is answering an act with recompense; it establishes the surah's explicit action-to-return rule.
The branch is purposive action; it identifies what enters that rule.
The branch is increase by adding an equal; it converts the earlier return into multiplied return.

structural_cues: 34:3 places the smallest and largest alike in a clear record.
34:4 gives the same faith, work, and recompense sequence that 34:37 expands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies particle-scale inclusion, an obligating record, and the repeated action-recompense sequence; I infer a ledger-like arrow from registered act to doubled return. Alternatively, the record may primarily assert exhaustive knowledge, with accounting only a secondary resonance.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah contrasts large worldly quantities with a generously doubled reward.
changed_reading.after: It contrasts conspicuous stored quantity with particle-sensitive moral accounting in which purposive acts, not holdings, are registered and multiplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: David's gift becomes softened resistant material, then measured, linked craft, and finally thankful work. This supplies a concrete causal grammar for the focus exception: endowed capacity or material is not itself nearness; it becomes eligible action when deliberately transformed, proportioned, connected, and rendered as gratitude.

activation_trace.role: The branch is benefaction and gift; it supplies endowed capacity before any human claim to merit.
The branch is softness opposed to roughness; it makes resistant material workable.
The branch is iron and resistant hardness; it supplies the material that gift and work transform.
The branch is the measure by which a thing reaches its limit; it makes proportion part of good fabrication.
The branch is successive things connected to one another; it supplies coherent assembly rather than raw accumulation.
The branch is intentional action; its repetition turns material capacity into accountable craft.
The branch is recognizing a gift and praising its giver; it names the craft's relational orientation.
The branch is fitness for its object; it receives measured, connected craft as a concrete model of fitting work.

structural_cues: 34:10-11 moves from bestowed surplus through softened iron to measured linked fabrication.
34:13 labels continued making as gratitude and notes its rarity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, transformed material, measure, connection, repeated work, and gratitude; I infer gift to disciplined making to grateful relation as a model for fitting action. Alternatively, the craft episode may exemplify gratitude without defining the focus phrase's full scope.

changed_reading.before: Good work is a generic moral category opposed to wealth.
changed_reading.after: Good work can be read as the disciplined conversion of gifted capacities and materials into proportioned, connected, grateful making; the unworked gift itself grants no access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Saba's visible network of settlements makes travel continuously traversable and safe, yet the request to produce distance is followed by being torn into scattered pieces and made exemplary reports. The focus ayah then relocates security from abundant connected infrastructure to faith and fitting action: nearness must be relationally inhabited, not presumed from assets.

activation_trace.role: The branch is ongoing movement and passage; it supplies a traversable connected network.
The branch is settled safety; it marks the network's original secure condition.
The branch is actively causing distance; it makes separation a requested transformation rather than an accident.
The branch is tearing into dispersed pieces; it supplies the realized social and spatial fragmentation.
The branch is answering conduct with recompense; it links lost connectedness to accountable response.
The branch is nearness opposed to distance; it makes the focus promise a reversal of Saba's chosen separation.

structural_cues: 34:15 supplies gardens, provision, and a good settlement before the reversal.
34:18-19 runs from visible connected villages and safe travel to requested distance and dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a safe network, an explicit demand for distance, and ensuing fragmentation; I infer that refused relational nearness turns infrastructure into separation. Alternatively, the primary arrow may be ingratitude to loss, with distance functioning as its narrative symptom.

changed_reading.before: The final safety of the focus ayah is simply one reward among others.
changed_reading.after: Safety becomes restored connectedness after Saba's failure: property and infrastructure cannot preserve nearness when their holders choose distance, whereas faith and fitting action culminate in secure placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ownership-intercession sequence removes every ordinary route of leveraged access: no ownership, share, supporting backer, or advocate joined to another can operate independently, and presence with God is governed by permission. Wealth and children therefore fail not merely as merits but as proxy networks imagined to purchase or broker admission.

activation_trace.role: The branch is ownership with power of disposal; its negation removes proprietary leverage.
The branch is partnership and shared stake; its negation removes delegated shares in access.
The branch is strength gained from a back or helper; its negation removes supporting patronage.
The branch is an advocate joining another person; it supplies the last possible interpersonal proxy.
The branch is presence and nearness at someone; it places the proxy question at the same destination sought in the focus ayah.
The branch is permission and authorization; it makes admitted access granted rather than brokered.
The branch is abundant property; it is exposed as one imagined source of leverage.
The branch is offspring and lineage; it is exposed as the imagined interpersonal access network.

structural_cues: 34:22 exhausts ownership, partnership, and supporting-help relations.
34:23 allows joined advocacy only under authorization and uses the same presence construction as the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a serial cancellation of proprietary and social proxies before permission-governed presence; I infer that wealth and lineage instantiate those failed leverage systems. Alternatively, the sequence may target cultic partners specifically while only analogically illuminating social assets.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and children fail because they are morally inferior to faith and deeds.
changed_reading.after: They also fail as brokerage systems: neither property nor lineage can own, share, back, or independently advocate a person into divine presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, those made weak and those claiming greatness exchange blame, action is repaid, chains materialize domination, and the wealthy cite more property and children as immunity. Provision is then shown as expanded or constricted by another agency. Against that sequence, the same root moves from imposed weakness to increase-by-an-equal in the focus reward, allowing doubled recompense to sound reparative as well as quantitative.

The branch is purposive action; it identifies the basis of that recompense despite status claims.
The branch is abundance of property; it supplies the elite's explicit immunity claim.
The branch is offspring and lineage; it completes the claimed shield of status.
The branch is expansion, increase, and surplus; it relativizes present abundance as allocated variation.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stages the socially weakened against self-magnifying leaders and ends with recompense according to work.
34:35-37 moves without interruption from the wealth-and-children immunity claim through variable provision to doubled recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated weakness root, the hierarchy, the asset boast, reversible provision, and then increase by an equal; I infer a reparative arrow from imposed weakness to multiplied return. Alternatively, the focus occurrence may carry only its ordinary quantitative branch, with the social echo serving emphasis rather than repair.

changed_reading.before: The doubled recompense is sheer numerical generosity unrelated to the preceding social conflict.
changed_reading.after: The increase can also answer the making-weak of persons: status-backed domination loses its metric, while action-based recompense turns the weakness root toward restorative multiplication.

context_deltas.mechanism: After property is denied as an access credential, the surah does not make it inert or evil: allotted provision can leave possession as expenditure, after which another thing comes behind and takes its place. Wealth changes function from static proof of standing to material released through action into a replacement circuit.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allotted provision, outgoing wealth, and replacement; I infer possession to release to renewed provision as a circuit that distinguishes wealth from its use. Alternatively, 34:39 may promise replacement generally without specifying that expenditure contributes to the focus ayah's fitting work.

changed_reading.before: Because wealth cannot bring near, it is simply excluded from the verse's positive route.
changed_reading.after: Wealth is excluded as a credential but recoverable as material for intentional release: its ethical force appears when possession becomes expenditure within a provision-and-replacement circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later single exhortation decomposes response into bodily rising with resolve, the small social scales of two and one, and repeated inward consideration. This gives the focus's intentional fitting work an epistemic practice: action begins by leaving crowd-backed status, standing responsibly, and testing the claim in pair or solitude.

changed_reading.before: Work in the focus ayah primarily means outward moral performance.
changed_reading.after: Its scope can include disciplined inquiry: responsible standing, release from crowd metrics, and sustained reflection are themselves part of action fitted to truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence opposes truth cast effectively in the present to conjecture cast from a remote position, then makes nearness a condition of hearing and capture while belated faith cannot stretch across distance once a barrier intervenes. The focus's nearness becomes temporal and epistemic reachability: faith must become fitting action while response can still arrive, not after possessions, desires, or late assertion have lost access.

34:50-54 compresses near hearing, near capture, failed reaching from afar, and a final barrier into one closing movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated near and far language, failed reaching, late assent, and an intervening barrier; I infer spatial distance to temporal-epistemic inaccessibility as the directional shift. Alternatively, the sequence may remain specifically eschatological and spatial, with present-time reachability only an analogical extension.

changed_reading.before: Bringing near in the focus ayah describes the eventual rank awarded to believers.
changed_reading.after: It also names a live condition of response: assent must become fitting action within reach of truth, because late verbal belief cannot traverse the distance once access has closed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates water-seeking and vessel branches rather than the ordinary abstract proximity senses. It remains anchored in the focus roots for bringing near, nearness, and lifting, and the surah supplies collected water and flood imagery; downstream prose should present it only as a material echo of orientation toward a source, not as the lexical meaning of the focus clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines bringing near, nearness, and chambers whose root also means lifting or taking up.

activation_trace.role: The branch is night movement toward a water source; it recasts approach as source-directed travel.

The branch is flood flow; it shows that abundant water can also destroy an asset system rather than confer nearness.

changed_reading.before: Proximity and chambers are purely social-spatial rank images.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse can echo a waterward mechanism: assets do not carry one to the source, while faithful action is oriented approach, reception, lifting, and protected fullness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping of the recompense root into cutting and combines it with the lifting branch of the chamber root. It remains formally anchored in three contiguous reward words and yields a coherent allocation sequence; downstream prose must mark it as branch play, not replace the ordinary sense of recompense with an etymological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The contiguous reward phrase joins recompense, equal increase, and chambers, while the packet exposes cutting, multiplication, and lifting branches for those roots.

activation_trace.role: The split-mapped branch is cutting a thing apart; it supplies the exploratory image of delimiting an allotted portion.
The branch is adding an equal to a thing; it doubles the delimited portion.

changed_reading.before: The reward clause states recompense, multiplication, and residence as separate benefits.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material activation, it can picture one allocation process: a portion is delimited, doubled, lifted, and settled as secure upper lodging.

strongest_changes: The near/far closing sequence turns nearness from eventual rank into live temporal and epistemic reachability.
The Saba narrative makes secure connectedness fragile when holders of abundance choose distance, so safety is relational rather than infrastructural.
The ownership and intercession sequence exposes wealth and lineage as failed brokerage systems, not merely inferior merits.
The weakness root's movement from socially weakened people to increased recompense gives doubling a possible reparative force.
Davidic craft and later expenditure show how gifts and wealth acquire value only when transformed into measured, grateful, outgoing action.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence changed the focus from a static wealth-versus-piety maxim into a network of access, movement, social power, accountable making, circulation, and timely reach. The most distinctive activations were the weakness-to-increase root reversal and the final collapse of belated reaching from afar.
remaining_uncertainties: The reparative force of the weakness and doubling recurrence may be rhetorical resonance rather than a second operative sense in the focus noun.
The Davidic craft sequence may exemplify grateful work without delimiting the full category of fitting action.
The waterward and allotted-portion outliers are coherent branch activations but should remain explicitly exploratory and non-lexical.
The closing near and far sequence may be primarily eschatological, so its extension to present epistemic timing remains an inference.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Nearness is relational access produced by trusted action, not carried assets.** `ق ر ب/B004` is favor and privileged access, `ز ل ف/B002` near standing, `ء م ن/B002` trusting assent, `ع م ل/B001` intentional work, and `ص ل ح/B001` soundness. The double negation removes wealth and offspring as transport; the exception substitutes faith and sound work. Access is the destination, and trusted action the admitted relation. The packet gives exclusion and exception; I infer that nearness is qualitative alignment rather than spatial purchase.
2. **The return adds an equal and lifts.** `ض ع ف/B002` is adding an equal amount and `غ ر ف/B002` an upper chamber. Matched work receives multiplied return and elevated secure dwelling. I infer vertical lift from relational nearness; the ayah preserves recompense while denying the elite’s asset-based route to it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:51 made `قريب` threatening rather than privileged, a sharp correction: nearness is not intrinsically reward but immediate relation to whichever outcome one has approached.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Imposed weakness reversed into multiplication.** `ض ع ف B002` supplies adding an equal amount, while `ض ع ف B001` supplies lack of strength. The same root has named those made weak in 34:32-33, inside this ayah's focus window; here it names multiplied recompense for faith and work. The branches assign social weakness the imposed condition and doubling the evaluative reversal. The packet supplies the close root recurrence; I infer that the reward answers the hierarchy's grammar on its own lexical ground. `جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ` reads as reversal of manufactured weakness, not quantity alone.

2. **Relational nearness spatialized as secure elevation.** `ق ر ب B004` supplies privileged access, `ز ل ف B001` advancing into nearness, and `غ ر ف B002` an upper chamber. Wealth and children fail to lift their holders, but faith and work lead to recompense in elevated rooms. The branches assign approach the relational cause and chambers its spatial outcome. The packet supplies negated assets and positive acts; I infer that moral approach, not accumulation, produces elevation. Nearness reads as granted architecture rather than social status.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:42 corrected any reading of chamber-security as a creaturely social asset: no party owns benefit or harm for another. The secure elevation of 34:37 is therefore granted relation, not a network privilege that inhabitants can trade.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3: Quantity and Proximity Run on Different Economies
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material quantity is variably expanded or restricted, while genuine proximity is produced through belief, work, secure recompense, and expenditure that re-enters provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The `ض ع ف` field reverses its role inside P3: socially weakened people in 34:31-33 are followed by doubled recompense in 34:37, unsettling the hierarchy that equates present strength with rank.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Nearness Recomputed as Enacted Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Wealth and offspring fail to move their holders closer, while belief and action are converted into multiplied recompense, elevated chambers, and security.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: relational nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`), assent of belief (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`), purposive work (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`), multiplication (`quranic:root_000909:B002/m01`), upper chambers (`quranic:root_001079:B002/m01`), security and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Proximity is not purchased by what one has but generated by what one enacts. The resulting multiplication is qualitative as well as numerical because it terminates in secure placement.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sahip olunan değerli varlıkları ve bunların çoğulunu; kişinin kendisi için varlık edinmesini, varlığının çoğalmasını ya da varlıklı duruma gelmesini ve başkasını varlık sahibi kılmasını birlikte aktarır. Göçebe toplulukların varlığının hayvan sürüleriyle somutlaşması bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı bir özelleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca para ya da birikmiş değer değildir; varlığın kendisini, edinilmesini, artmasını, varlıklı duruma geçişi ve başkasına varlık kazandırmayı ayırarak kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel varlık ve varlık edinme çekirdeğini ayrı tutar; göçebe toplulukların hayvan sürülerini varlık sayan kullanımını yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı özelleşme olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin sahip olduğu değerli varlıkların bütünü ile bunları edinme, çoğaltma ya da bunlara sahip duruma gelme alanıdır. Ayrıca başkasını varlık sahibi kılmayı kapsar; göçebe topluluklara özgü kullanımda sahip olunan varlık özellikle hayvan sürüleridir.

facets.statement: Kişinin sahip olduğu ve değer taşıyan varlıkların bütünü bu dalın ad çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Göçebe toplulukların varlığına ilişkin belirli kullanımda bu varlık, hayvan sürüleriyle somutlaşır.
Kişinin kendisi için değerli varlık edinmesi ve onu kalıcı sahiplik konusu yapması eylem çekirdeğidir.
Kişinin varlığının çoğalması ya da onun varlık sahibi bir duruma geçmesi ayrı bir süreç görünümüdür.
Bir başkasına değerli varlık vererek onu varlık sahibi duruma getirmek, çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısıdır.
Bir kimsenin varlığının çokluğuna şaşma bildiren söyleyiş, artış ve bolluk görünümüne bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, sahip olunan değerli varlıkları ve bunların çoğulunu temel alır; varlık edinme, varlığın çoğalması, varlıklı duruma gelme ve başkasını varlık sahibi kılma süreçlerini bu temel çevresinde birleştirir. Hayvan sürüleri göçebe topluluklara özgü somutlaşma, çokluk karşısındaki şaşma söyleyişi ise bağlı bir kullanım olarak aktarılır. Mal adının küçültme biçimi de ayrıca kaydedilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle taşınmazı, gelir getiren yeri ve bunları edinip kalıcı sahiplik konusu yapmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, değer taşıyan bir şeyi edinme ve kalıcı sahiplik altında bulundurma düşüncesinde birleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşunun çekirdeği belirli bir mülk ve taşınmaz türüne yönelirken odak dal varlığın türünü sınırlandırmaz; ayrıca artış, varlıklı duruma geçiş ve ettirgen kazandırma anlamlarını içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal varlığın genel adını, edinilmesini ve başkasının varlık sahibi yapılmasını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal büyüyen ya da çok olan varlığı, onun iyi yönetilmesini ve artması yönündeki iyi dileği özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: artan varlık ve onu iyi yönetme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da sahip olunan varlığın çokluğu veya artışı belirgin bir ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme varlık artışıyla sınırlıdır. Odak dal sahiplik ve edinme ailesini kurarken komşu, büyüyen varlık ile onun bakımı ve artışına ilişkin değerlendirmeleri ayrı bir çekirdek yapar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sekiz adayın tümü karşılaştırıldı. Edinme ve varlık artışıyla doğrudan sınır paylaşan üç aday yayımlandı; para yönetimi, belirli varlık türleri, geçim ve sürü adlandırmalarıyla yalnızca uzak alan ortaklığı kuran ötekiler dal sınırını keskinleştirmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المال والأموال واتخاذ المال قنية وكثرة المال وصيرورة الرجل ذا مال وتمويل غيره ونعم أهل البادية
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس للمولة العنكبوت ولا للميل عن الوسط ولا لميل الحائط
branches.source_phrase_ar: تمول الرجل اتخذ مالا؛ مال يمال كثر ماله (maqayis)؛ المال معروف وجمعه أموال؛ كانت أموال العرب أنعامهم؛ رجل مال أي ذو مال والفعل تمول (ayn)؛ مال الرجل يمول ويمال إذا صار ذا مال؛ تمول مثله؛ موله غيره (sihah)؛ مال أهل البادية النعم؛ تمول فلان مالا إذا اتخذ قنية من المال؛ ما أموله أي ما أكثر ماله (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü örümceğe verilen bir ad olarak aktarır, fakat aynı ifadenin içinde bu aktarımın kuşkuyla karşılandığını ve güvenilir bir aktarıcıdan işitilmediğini de açıkça bildirir. Bu nedenle hayvanla kurulan bağ korunabilir, ancak yerleşik ve tartışmasız bir ad gibi sunulamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, örümceğin özelliklerini tanımlamaz; yalnızca örümcek için aktarılan ve güvenilirliği açıkça tartışılan bir adlandırmayı temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kanıt, bu tartışmalı adlandırmanın bağımsız ve yerleşik bir yalın sözlük birimi olup olmadığını mekanik olarak çözmez; tanım bu yüzden yalın kullanım varsaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Örümceğe verilen bir ad olarak aktarılır; ancak bu adlandırmanın güvenilirliği kaynak anlatımının kendi içinde açıkça tartışmalıdır.

facets.statement: Sözcük, bazı sözlük aktarımlarında örümceği gösteren bir hayvan adı olarak verilir.
Adlandırmanın doğruluğu ve güvenilir aktarımı açıkça sorgulandığı için bu gönderim kesin kabul edilemez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kaydı sözcüğü örümceğin adı olarak aktarır, fakat aynı kayıtta bu eşleştirmenin kuşkulu olduğu ve güvenilir bir kaynaktan işitilmediği yönünde açık çekinceler bulunur. Bu yüzden hayvana gönderim ile aktarımın belirsizliği birlikte korunmalıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözcüğün örümceğe gönderimi aktarılırken bu adlandırmanın güvenilirliğine ilişkin açık kuşkunun da korunması gereken her durumda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem örümceğe gönderimi hem de bu gönderimin güvenilirliğine ilişkin kaynak içi çekinceyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tartışmalı hayvan adının bir metinde doğrudan canlıya gönderim yaptığı bağlamda akıcı karşılık olarak kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Adlandırmanın gönderimde bulunduğu hayvanı doğru biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu adlandırmanın güvenilirliği ve yerleşikliği üzerindeki açık kaynak kuşkusunu görünmez kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, aynı canlıya yönelen fakat güvenilirliği açıkça tartışılan özel bir ad aktarımıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal canlının olağan adını, ağ örme niteliğini, ad çeşitlerini ve dil bilgisel biçimlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın hayvansal gönderimi aynı canlıya, yani örümceğe yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim ortak olsa da odak dalın sözlüksel kimliği kuşkulu bir ad aktarımına bağlıdır. Komşu dal ise canlının doğrudan adını ve onu tanıtan özellikleri kapsadığı için iki adın kullanım sınırları tam olarak eşleşmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın örümcek adı sayılması kaynak anlatımında açık kuşku ve güven sorunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başka bir örümcek adının yanı sıra o örümceğin yuvasını gösteren bağlı bir söz öbeğini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: örümcek ve yuvası için özel ad
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da örümceğe verilen alışılmadık bir adlandırma üzerinden aynı canlıya gönderimde bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnızca kuşkulu hayvan adı aktarımıyla sınırlıdır; komşu dalın kendi ayrı adı ve yuvayı gösteren bağlı kullanımı vardır. Bu ek kapsam ve odaktaki güvenilirlik çekincesi tam eşdeğerliği engeller.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dokuz adayın tümü değerlendirildi. Aynı canlıya yönelen iki adlandırma gerçek bir sınır karşılaştırması sağladı; öteki hayvan adları yalnızca geniş canlılar alanını paylaştı, varlık dalı ise ortak köke rağmen anlamsal örtüşme göstermedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إطلاق المولة أو المول على العنكبوت إذا ثبتت النسبة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس للمال والأموال ولا لاتخاذ القنية ولا لكثرة المال

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ana babadan doğan çocuğu temel alır ve bu adlandırmanın tek ya da çok kişi, kız ya da erkek, küçük ya da yetişkin için kullanılabildiğini açıkça belirtir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu kapsamı doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, doğuran ana babayı ve doğurma olayını değil, bu olay sonucunda dünyaya gelen kişiyi gösterir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, doğan kişiye ilişkin yalın çekirdeği temel alır; listedeki kalıba bağlı ve türemiş kullanımlar ayrı sözlük karşılıklarında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir ana babadan doğan kişi; bu kişi tek ya da birden çok, kız ya da erkek, küçük ya da yetişkin olabilir.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, bir ana babadan doğmuş kişidir.
Adlandırma sayı, cinsiyet ve yaş bakımından sınırlı değildir; bir veya çok kişiyi, kız veya erkeği, küçüğü veya yetişkini gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, ana babadan doğan kişidir. Kullanımın tekillik, çoğulluk, cinsiyet ve yaş sınırlarını aşabildiği de aynı toplu kanıtta belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: ana babadan doğan kişi veya kişiler
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bütün çekirdeğini karşılar; tek ve çok kişi ile kız, erkek, küçük ve yetişkin kullanımlarının hepsine açıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğumdan gelen çocukluk bağını ve sayı, cinsiyet, yaş genişliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir kişinin ana babasına göre konumunu anlatan doğal cümlelerde kullanılır; kişinin yaşını veya cinsiyetini sınırlamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Ana babadan doğmuş kişi olma bağını bağlam içinde eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir ana babadan doğan birden çok kişiden söz edilen çoğul bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğum bağını ve çoğul gönderimi ilgili bağlamda korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birinin çocuğu; bir veya birden çok doğmuş kişi

error_profile.preserves: Ana babadan doğan kişi olma bağını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kızları ve cinsiyetten bağımsız genel kullanımı dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğmuş ve küçük bir kişi olma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Daha büyük çocuklar ile yetişkin çocuklara uzanan yaş kapsamını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, insan çocuğunun sayı, cinsiyet ve yaş bakımından geniş adlandırılmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, birbirinden çoğalmayı ve soy üretmek için tutulan hayvanları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da doğan çocuk ve soyun sürmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği doğmuş kişidir; komşu dal ise çocuk yanında karşılıklı çoğalma sürecini ve hayvanların üretim amacını da anlamın içine alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, doğmuş kişinin kendisini sayı, cinsiyet ve yaştan bağımsız biçimde adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal evlat edinmeyi, yetiştirmeyi, hizmeti ve bir kaynaktan gelme benzetmelerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da oğul, kız ve çocuk olma bağında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal gerçek doğum sonucundaki kişiye dayanır; komşu dal çocukluk bağını doğum dışındaki edinme, yetiştirme ve kaynaktan gelme ilişkilerine genişletir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal her yaştaki çocuğu kapsar ve kölelik konumunu anlamın parçası yapmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yakın zamanda doğmuş çocuğa ve ayrıca erkek ya da kadın köleye özgü kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: çocuk / yeni doğmuş çocuk veya köle
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yakın zamanda doğmuş çocuk, iki dalın kesiştiği alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çocukluk bağını yaş sınırlaması olmadan verir; komşu dal yeni doğmuşluk çevresinde daralır ve ayrıca yaşla sınırlı olmayan köle anlamını taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal doğrudan ana babadan doğan kişiyi ve genel çocuk adlandırmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin ardından kalan çocukları, çocuklarının çocuklarını ve süren soy çizgisini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da çocuk ve soy bağı alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği doğmuş çocukken komşu dal kuşaklar boyunca geride kalan soyun devamına ve torunlara yönelir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Verilen bütün komşu adayları değerlendirildi; yayımlanan dört karşılaştırma doğrudan çocuk, geniş çocukluk bağı, yeni doğmuşluk ve süren soy sınırlarını en açık biçimde ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الولد والمولود والابن والابنة والأولاد، ويستعمل للواحد والجمع وللصغير والكبير وللذكر والأنثى بحسب نصوص المصادر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل هنا خصوص الأب أو الأم، ولا نفس فعل الولادة، ولا معنى العبد أو الأمة للوليد والوليدة إلا من جهة تسمية الصغير.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, babayı doğum bağı yönünden baba, anayı da aynı yönden ana olarak adlandırır ve ikisini birlikte bir çift halinde verir. Dal çerçevesi bu üçlü dağılımı doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ana baba, çocuğa göre doğum bağı taşıyan iki kişidir; çocuk, bakıcı veya daha uzak büyükler bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ana, baba ve ikisini birlikte gösteren adlandırmayla sınırlıdır; başka aile veya bakım ilişkileri içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir çocuğun doğum bağıyla bağlı olduğu öz babası, öz anası ve bu ikisinin birlikte oluşturduğu ana baba çifti.

facets.statement: Erkek yönündeki kişi, çocuğun öz babasıdır.
Kadın yönündeki kişi, çocuğun öz anasıdır.
İki kişi birlikte çocuğun ana babası olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar babayı, anayı ve ikisini birlikte gösteren ana baba çiftini aynı doğum bağı içinde ortak biçimde tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çocuğun doğum bağıyla bağlı olduğu babayı, anayı veya ikisini birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ana, baba ve çift halindeki ana baba kapsamını doğum bağıyla birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğum bağının erkek tarafındaki tek kişiden söz edildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Baba yönündeki doğum bağını ilgili tekil bağlamda tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğum bağının kadın tarafındaki tek kişiden söz edildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ana yönündeki doğum bağını ilgili tekil bağlamda tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki doğum bağı kişisinin birlikte anıldığı cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ana ve babayı birlikte gösteren çift kapsamını korur.
